facts.fact: Lusa reports the government opened a tender to design and build an internet portal covering the whole life cycle of a company, with a first phase due by the end of the year and links to INPS, IGT, INCV and Pro-Empresa.

CPV.note: Document names no strategy, only a general digital transformation strategy for public services.
Document does not say who builds or runs the portal; a firm is to be selected.
